message.content: Starting from the flagged run, I'll shrink the failure to its minimal repro and gather the evidence needed for the report.
Shrinking isolated a one-body, high-speed bounce. I'll replay it and examine the states around the violation to determine the cause.
The bounce is adding energy instead of conserving it. I'll test a counterfactual to isolate the trigger before finalizing the report.
A single change eliminates the energy violation, confirming the root cause. I'll submit the full triage report.

function.arguments: {"scenario_id":"sc453aa1937","rule":"energy_bound","explanation":"Shrunk case is a single body with e=1 starting just below ceiling (y=11.6, r~0.30, ceiling at 12) moving upward at ~40 m/s with dt~0.0287. It hits ceiling within step 1, triggering many substeps (40+). After bounce, |vy| grows from 40.47 to 40.73 to 42.42 to 44.12, faster than gravity alone (g*dt~0.28). Mechanical energy rises from E0=971.9 to 973.0 to 1031.7 to 1092.7 at step 3, exceeding allowed E0*1.1+5=1074.16. Likely cause: restitution=1 collision with implicit arena boundary plus positional correction injects energy when resolved inside substeps, compounding each step.
